routes.name: Dunn Westbay
routes.approach: This is a big-wall aid route, so many parties avoid hauling up North Chimney, where loose rock is dangerous, and instead rappel from the Chasm View bolts, on a large detached block, to Broadway. Once on Broadway, begin right of North Chimney on the right side of the large Green Pillar, up ramps to a big right-facing dihedral.
